At **New Leaf Consulting**, we bridge the gap between human resources and advanced data analytics. Modern businesses lose countless hours and capital to unoptimized hiring, hidden turnover drivers, and disconnected data systems.

We provide actionable, data-backed solutions to optimize your workforce, protect your company from compliance risks, and give your management team their time back.

## Predictive Turnover & Data Integration

Understanding why employees leave shouldn't be based on guesswork or exit interviews alone. New Leaf can turn your scattered HR data into clear, actionable insights.
:::
:::

::: {.grid .service-grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.service-card}
### Turnover Root-Cause Analysis

New Leaf can aggregate and clean your historical data to identify the exact variables driving employee churn. We build the models so you can make proactive retention decisions.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.service-card}
### Data Pipelines & Hygiene

Most companies struggle with multiple, unsynced HRIS systems. New Leaf can design automated data pipelines that warehouse your data, ensuring all your platforms "talk" to each other seamlessly.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.impact-label}
